items.text: Browns placed RB Dylan Sampson on injured reserve (knee) and signed Jaleel McLaughlin from practice squad.
items.why: Serious left knee, crutches/brace post-game; significant time expected.
items.implication: Judkins/Sanders see more work; handcuff elevated.
items.opportunity: Quinshon Judkins role expansion; Raheim Sanders backup snaps.

items.text: A.J. Brown high-ankle sprain more severe, expected ~6 weeks; placed on IR (miss at least 4).
items.why: High ankle confirmed, IR designation; Rapoport timeline longer than initial.
items.implication: Out until ~Week 6-7; stash if IR spot.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey dealing with rib injury, considered day-to-day per HC Jim Harbaugh; team will monitor how he feels this week before determining Week 2 availability vs Raiders.
items.why: Exited Week 1 with chest/rib issue after big hit; Harbaugh DTD, status up in air.
items.implication: Monitor practice; risk of missing or limited Week 2.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes for Tre Harris and other Chargers WRs if out.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers hamstring injury not considered serious; day-to-day, would have returned if playoff game, MRI pending but coach confirms DTD.
items.why: Left early after big performance (150 yds TD); soft-tissue but downplayed severity.
items.implication: Likely plays Week 2 or limited; high re-injury risk on hamstring.

items.text: Week 2 injury beneficiaries for waivers: McConkey=Tre Harris; Lane=Bateman/Moore; AJ Brown=Doubs/Douglas; Kamara=Kendre Miller; Sampson=Sanders; Murray=Wentz; Darnold=Lock; plus others like Vele for Tyson.
items.why: Direct injury replacements listed with FAAB/streaming guidance.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3 per coach; same left knee as prior PCL sprain/bone bruise last season, which is scary.
items.why: Coach Kubiak now DTD after procedure; working hard but history of knee issues.
items.implication: Potential early return boosts TE1 value; Mayer handcuff if delayed.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer elevated role if out.

items.text: Kenneth Walker true workhorse in KC debut: 29 of first 32 RB opportunities, 19 routes on 33 dropbacks, team-high 6 targets (22% share), 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec.
items.why: Dominated opportunities as expected post-trade to Chiefs.
items.implication: RB1 lock with elite volume and receiving work.

items.text: Kenneth Walker is a full grown man after monster MNF performance; strong love post-debut as Chiefs workhorse.
items.why: Explosive production and volume in new offense sealed Monday Night Miracle.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Watson dropbacks even after Dylan Sampson (knee) exited early; Browns used third-stringer Raheim Sanders for 13 routes too.
items.why: Limited passing-game role despite teammate injury.
items.implication: More of a pure runner; lower PPR floor than hoped.
items.opportunity: Carries may rise with Sampson IR but routes lag.

items.text: Kyler Murray in concussion protocol per coach O'Connell; status uncertain for Week 2, Wentz sparks optimism as backup.
items.why: Exited early after hard hit; protocol in medical hands.
items.implication: Wentz likely starter if no clear; stream option.

items.text: Travis Etienne did not dominate with Alvin Kamara (knee) out: snaps 53/26/15 Etienne/Miller/Donaldson; routes 24/5/7; opportunities 18/9/4.
items.implication: Etienne not full workhorse; Miller viable handcuff/flex.
items.opportunity: Kendre Miller elevated with Kamara absence.

items.text: Malik Nabers first game post-ACL/meniscus: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets team-high 31% share, 6-69-0; emerged healthy.
items.why: Solid snap/route/target share in return without setback.
items.implication: WR1 role intact post-injury; ramp-up complete.

items.text: Rashee Rice tiny career aDOT 4.9 (2.5 last night); only 2 targets 7% share but routes solid (29 of 33 Mahomes dropbacks, 2nd to Worthy). Needs volume to produce.
items.why: High route participation but low target share and short aDOT limits ceiling without more volume.
items.implication: Volume-dependent WR; monitor target share ROS.
items.opportunity: Routes present; upside if targets rise.

items.text: Sunday injuries watching include Zay Flowers (hamstring), Ladd McConkey (chest), plus others; Kamara status affects Etienne projections.
items.why: Early post-game flags on key skill players.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 2 availability and beneficiary roles.
